name: Remove Hunger and Thirst
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level alchemist/investigator 3, bard/skald 3, cleric/oracle/warpriest 3, druid 3, hunter 3, inquisitor 3, medium 2, mesmerist 3, paladin 2, psychic 3, ranger 2, shaman 3, spiritualist 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fort negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

Remove hunger and thirst removes all the effects of natural and magical starvation and/or thirst, curing any lethal or nonlethal damage suffered from such effects. The spell doesn’t cure any other types of damage. It does not prevent new damage from later lack of food and/or drink.
